About this Event

✨ Kirtan Soulfest: Candles & Lights EditionStep into an evening of sacred sound and glowing light. This special edition of Kirtan Soulfest invites you to experience mantra meditation in a warm, candlelit atmosphere designed to nurture peace, joy, and connection.
We’ll chant timeless mantras in a call-and-response style, weaving together music, meditation, and community. Surrounded by soft candlelight, the space becomes an oasis—encouraging you to slow down, breathe deeper, and reconnect with yourself and others.
🌟 What to Expect:
Soulful mantra chanting (no experience needed—just your voice and an open heart)A candlelit atmosphere that inspires calm, reflection, and joyMovement, music, and meditation to uplift body, mind, and spiritA nourishing community meal to share together afterward💫 Why Join:
This gathering is for anyone looking to step out of daily stress and step into light. Whether you’re curious about meditation, looking for a fresh way to care for your well-being, or simply drawn to the beauty of music and connection, this night will leave you feeling grounded and glowing.
Bring your curiosity, your presence, and your light—and together we’ll create a night to remember.

🌸 WHAT TO EXPECTKirtan Soulfest is more than just music—it’s a sacred celebration of sound, movement, and community. Through ancient mantras sung in a joyful call-and-response style, you’ll experience the same method the Vedas prescribe for awakening our inner divinity. The chants, rhythms, and shared energy create an atmosphere that uplifts the mind, body, and heart all at once.
Come with an open heart, join in the singing and dancing, and share in a nourishing feast—leave with a renewed sense of clarity, connection, and love.
